transcript.text: Can you describe your experience preparing GST returns for 20 small clients at the chartered accountancy firm?

I cleared both groups of CA Intermediate in my first attempt, and I worked as an article assistant for about 18 months at a small firm in Ludhiana, preparing GST returns for 20 small clients. I then appeared for Group 1 of the CA Final in 2024 and did not clear it. I decided not to repeat it and finished my BCom instead. I'm applying for an MBA because I want to work in business decisions, not only compliance.
